{"text":"ItemID: 1; Title: PNY 128GB Turbo Attache 3 USB 3.0 Flash Drive, GREY; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Useful for moving files between my computers and keeping installation media alongside my microSD cards.
ItemID: 2; Title: Zyxel AV2000 Powerline Ethernet Adapter Starter Kit; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: My recent Ethernet adapter and cable purchases make this worth trying to extend wired connectivity, though performance would depend on my wiring.
ItemID: 3; Title: Belkin Surge Protector Power Strip w/ 8 Rotating & 4 Standard Outlets; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The rotating outlets look useful for fitting the power adapters around my computer and Raspberry Pi setup.
ItemID: 4; Title: VELCRO Brand ONE-WRAP Cable Ties, 100Pk, 8 x 1/2" Black Cord Organization Straps; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Reusable straps would complement my cable covers and make rearranging my desk cables easier than fixed cable ties.
ItemID: 5; Title: Panasonic ErgoFit Wired Earbuds - RP-TCM125-A (Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have several headphones in my history and have no clear need for another wired pair right now.
ItemID: 6; Title: BlueRigger HDMI to DVI Cable (15FT, High-Speed, Bi-Directional Adapter Male to Male); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My Raspberry Pi makes display cables relevant, but I have no stated need for a DVI connection or a 15-foot cable.
ItemID: 7; Title: BlueRigger Digital Optical Audio Toslink Cable (3FT, Fiber Optic Cord, 24K Gold-Plated); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases do not suggest an optical-audio setup that needs this cable.
ItemID: 8; Title: Amazon Basics Keyboard and 3-Button USB Mouse Combo; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a mini wireless keyboard and keyboard accessories, so a basic replacement combo is not compelling right now.
ItemID: 9; Title: Western Digital 4TB WD Red Plus NAS Internal Hard Drive HDD - WD40EFRX; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My memory-card purchases suggest storage needs, but they do not establish a need for a large internal NAS drive.
ItemID: 10; Title: Logitech C-U0007 Unifying Receiver for Mouse and Keyboard; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no indicated compatible Logitech device or missing receiver, so this would not solve a current need."}
